title: 分级 · 六级｜社会议题与批判论证 · 60 句
description: 激励后果、比较偏差、制度门槛、长期影响、公平与反驳；按六级层次练习抽象论证。

items.zh: 如果机构只奖励结案速度，工作人员可能倾向于避开最复杂的个案。
items.en: Rewarding an agency solely for closing cases quickly may encourage staff to avoid those requiring the most attention.
answers: Rewarding an agency solely for closing cases quickly may encourage staff to avoid those requiring the most attention.
items.notes: those requiring 回指复杂个案；solely 限定单一激励。

items.zh: 为了证明系统可靠而减少故障上报，反而会使管理者更难发现风险。
items.en: Suppressing fault reports to demonstrate reliability makes it harder for managers to detect the very risks they need to address.
answers: Suppressing fault reports to demonstrate reliability makes it harder for managers to detect the very risks they need to address.
items.notes: the very risks 强调本应发现的风险；动名词作主语。

items.zh: 当补贴按设备购买数量发放时，维护已有设备可能变得不那么有吸引力。
items.en: When subsidies are tied to equipment purchases, maintaining existing assets may become relatively unattractive.
answers: When subsidies are tied to equipment purchases, maintaining existing assets may become relatively unattractive.
items.notes: be tied to：与……挂钩；relatively 限定相对激励变化。

items.zh: 考核越强调容易计数的活动，就越可能忽视难以量化的支持工作。
items.en: The more assessment emphasises countable activities, the more likely it is to overlook support that resists quantification.
answers: The more assessment emphasises countable activities, the more likely it is to overlook support that resists quantification.
items.notes: the more ... the more ...；resist quantification：难以量化。

items.zh: 允许随时取消预约可以增加便利，却也可能使服务提供者难以安排人员。
items.en: Unrestricted cancellation improves convenience while making staffing less predictable for service providers.
answers: Unrestricted cancellation improves convenience while making staffing less predictable for service providers.
items.notes: while 表并存影响；predictable staffing：可预测的人员安排。

items.zh: 如果差评都会招致处罚，员工就可能避免主动征求反馈。
items.en: Where every negative review triggers a penalty, employees may become reluctant to solicit feedback.
answers: Where every negative review triggers a penalty, employees may become reluctant to solicit feedback.
items.notes: where 表情形；solicit feedback：主动征求反馈。

items.zh: 按点击付费的推荐可能更偏向立即引起反应的内容，而不是需要仔细阅读的内容。
items.en: Recommendations paid for by the click may favour immediate reactions over material requiring sustained attention.
answers: Recommendations paid for by the click may favour immediate reactions over material requiring sustained attention.
items.notes: favour A over B：偏重 A；requiring 限定内容特点。

items.zh: 当晋升主要取决于个人产出时，经验丰富的员工可能缺少指导新人的动力。
items.en: If promotion depends mainly on individual output, experienced staff may have little incentive to mentor newcomers.
answers: If promotion depends mainly on individual output, experienced staff may have little incentive to mentor newcomers.
items.notes: incentive to：做某事的动力；mentor：指导新人。

items.zh: 设立截止日期可以促进决策，但过短的期限也可能排除需要更多准备的人。
items.en: Deadlines can prompt decisions, yet excessively short ones may exclude people who need more time to prepare.
answers: Deadlines can prompt decisions, yet excessively short ones may exclude people who need more time to prepare.
items.notes: ones 替代 deadlines；excessively：过度地。

items.zh: 减少申报步骤只有在责任仍然清楚时，才算真正简化了程序。
items.en: Fewer reporting steps amount to genuine simplification only if responsibility remains clear.
answers: Fewer reporting steps amount to genuine simplification only if responsibility remains clear.
items.notes: amount to：构成；only if：必要条件。

items.zh: 只统计仍在运营的企业，会使人高估某种创业策略的成功率。
items.en: Counting only firms still in operation can inflate the apparent success rate of an entrepreneurial strategy.
answers: Counting only firms still in operation can inflate the apparent success rate of an entrepreneurial strategy.
items.notes: inflate：夸大；still in operation 限定幸存样本。

items.zh: 等待时间下降可能源于提前筛除了复杂申请，而不一定是处理能力提升。
items.en: Shorter waiting times may reflect the exclusion of complex applications rather than an improvement in processing capacity.
answers: Shorter waiting times may reflect the exclusion of complex applications rather than an improvement in processing capacity.
items.notes: rather than 引出指标改善的替代解释。

items.zh: 当满意度调查只通过手机应用开展时，没有智能手机的人可能不会出现在结果里。
items.en: Satisfaction surveys conducted exclusively through apps may leave people without smartphones out of the findings.
answers: Satisfaction surveys conducted exclusively through apps may leave people without smartphones out of the findings.
items.notes: conducted 作定语；leave ... out of：排除在外。

items.zh: 同样的合格率可能对应完全不同的申请者构成。
items.en: Identical pass rates can conceal substantial differences in the composition of the applicant pool.
answers: Identical pass rates can conceal substantial differences in the composition of the applicant pool.
items.notes: conceal：掩盖；applicant pool：申请者群体。

items.zh: 跨地区比较服务成本时，还需考虑人口密度造成的配送差异。
items.en: Regional comparisons of service costs should account for delivery differences arising from population density.
answers: Regional comparisons of service costs should account for delivery differences arising from population density.
items.notes: arising from：由……产生；account for：考虑到。

items.zh: 满意的使用者更愿意留下评价，也可能使总体印象偏向积极。
items.en: A greater willingness among satisfied users to leave reviews may tilt the overall impression towards the positive.
answers: A greater willingness among satisfied users to leave reviews may tilt the overall impression towards the positive.
items.notes: tilt ... towards：使偏向；主语中心是 willingness。

items.zh: 如果资格规则收紧，即使服务水平没有提高，完成率也可能上升。
items.en: Completion rates may rise after eligibility rules tighten even if service quality remains unchanged.
answers: Completion rates may rise after eligibility rules tighten even if service quality remains unchanged.
items.notes: even if 区分指标变化与服务变化；eligibility：资格。

items.zh: 成本平均分摊后，一些群体承担的额外负担可能从统计中消失。
items.en: Averaging costs across users may obscure the additional burdens borne by particular groups.
answers: Averaging costs across users may obscure the additional burdens borne by particular groups.
items.notes: borne by：由……承担；obscure：遮蔽。

items.zh: 以登记住址划分服务人口，可能遗漏长期流动的居民。
items.en: Defining service populations by registered address may omit residents whose living arrangements remain mobile.
answers: Defining service populations by registered address may omit residents whose living arrangements remain mobile.
items.notes: whose 引出居民的居住状况；registered：登记的。

items.zh: 衡量项目覆盖面时，应区分第一次接触服务的人和反复参加的人。
items.en: Measures of programme reach should distinguish first-time users from repeat participants.
answers: Measures of programme reach should distinguish first-time users from repeat participants.
items.notes: programme reach：项目覆盖面；distinguish ... from ...。

items.zh: 要求申请者先承担费用再报销，可能把最需要支持的人挡在门外。
items.en: Requiring applicants to pay upfront and claim reimbursement later can exclude those most in need of support.
answers: Requiring applicants to pay upfront and claim reimbursement later can exclude those most in need of support.
items.notes: pay upfront：预先支付；those most in need：最需要支持的人。

items.zh: 表面一致的身份核验规则，可能给证件不易补办的人带来更大负担。
items.en: Uniform identity checks can impose heavier burdens on people whose documents are difficult to replace.
answers: Uniform identity checks can impose heavier burdens on people whose documents are difficult to replace.
items.notes: uniform：统一的；whose 从句解释负担差异。

items.zh: 协商会议开放，并不意味着没有照护替代安排的人能够出席。
items.en: An open consultation does not ensure attendance by people who lack alternative care arrangements.
answers: An open consultation does not ensure attendance by people who lack alternative care arrangements.
An open consultation doesn't ensure attendance by people who lack alternative care arrangements.
items.notes: consultation：意见协商；alternative care arrangements：替代照护安排。

items.zh: 如果申诉必须使用原本就有问题的渠道，纠错机制便可能失去作用。
items.en: An appeals mechanism may fail when complaints must pass through the very channel alleged to be defective.
answers: An appeals mechanism may fail when complaints must pass through the very channel alleged to be defective.
items.notes: the very channel 强调矛盾；alleged to be：被指称为。

items.zh: 资格证明过分依赖连续就业记录，可能低估无偿照护所培养的技能。
items.en: Heavy reliance on uninterrupted employment records may undervalue skills developed through unpaid care.
answers: Heavy reliance on uninterrupted employment records may undervalue skills developed through unpaid care.
items.notes: uninterrupted：连续的；developed through 修饰技能。

items.zh: 提供多种申请方式，只有在这些方式受到同等认真处理时才有意义。
items.en: Multiple application routes matter only when submissions through each receive equally serious consideration.
answers: Multiple application routes matter only when submissions through each receive equally serious consideration.
items.notes: only when：只有在……时；submission：提交的申请。

items.zh: 公众参与若发生在关键决定之后，就可能只剩下确认既定方案的作用。
items.en: Participation introduced after key decisions have been made may serve merely to endorse an established plan.
answers: Participation introduced after key decisions have been made may serve merely to endorse an established plan.
items.notes: serve to：起到……作用；endorse：认可。

items.zh: 要求公开个人困境才能获得帮助，可能降低人们申请服务的意愿。
items.en: Making assistance conditional on publicly disclosing hardship may discourage people from applying.
answers: Making assistance conditional on publicly disclosing hardship may discourage people from applying.
items.notes: make ... conditional on：以……为条件；hardship：困境。

items.zh: 对规则的例外处理应留有记录，以免灵活性变成难以解释的差别待遇。
items.en: Exceptions to rules should be documented lest flexibility turn into unexplained differential treatment.
answers: Exceptions to rules should be documented lest flexibility turn into unexplained differential treatment.
items.notes: lest：以免；differential treatment：差别待遇。

items.zh: 被邀请参与讨论的人，还需要拥有真正影响议程的机会。
items.en: An invitation to participate needs to be accompanied by a genuine opportunity to influence the agenda.
answers: An invitation to participate needs to be accompanied by a genuine opportunity to influence the agenda.
items.notes: be accompanied by：伴随；influence the agenda：影响议程。

items.zh: 一项临时技术方案可能因为培训和数据迁移成本而长期保留下来。
items.en: A temporary technical solution may persist because replacing it entails training and data-migration costs.
answers: A temporary technical solution may persist because replacing it entails training and data-migration costs.
items.notes: entail：必然涉及；persist：持续存在。

items.zh: 早期选择形成的依赖，可能限制后来采用更合适工具的空间。
items.en: Dependencies created by early choices can constrain the later adoption of more suitable tools.
answers: Dependencies created by early choices can constrain the later adoption of more suitable tools.
items.notes: created by 作定语；constrain：限制。

items.zh: 短期租约给予使用者灵活性，也可能使他们不愿投入长期改造。
items.en: Short leases offer flexibility while discouraging occupants from investing in improvements with distant returns.
answers: Short leases offer flexibility while discouraging occupants from investing in improvements with distant returns.
items.notes: distant returns：很久后才获得的回报；while 表权衡。

items.zh: 今天推迟的维护费用，可能以更高的停运成本在未来出现。
items.en: Maintenance costs deferred today may reappear as greater disruption costs in the future.
answers: Maintenance costs deferred today may reappear as greater disruption costs in the future.
items.notes: deferred：推迟的；reappear as：以另一形式再次出现。

items.zh: 项目的早期参与者和后来加入者，未必面对相同的学习环境。
items.en: Early adopters and later entrants may encounter different learning environments within the same programme.
answers: Early adopters and later entrants may encounter different learning environments within the same programme.
items.notes: early adopter：早期采用者；entrant：加入者。

items.zh: 不断更换资助重点可能使组织缺少把已经启动的工作做完的时间。
items.en: Continually shifting funding priorities can deprive organisations of the time needed to complete work already under way.
answers: Continually shifting funding priorities can deprive organisations of the time needed to complete work already under way.
items.notes: deprive ... of ...：使失去；under way：已经进行中。

items.zh: 一种做法被沿用多年，并不足以证明其原先的理由仍然成立。
items.en: A practice's longevity does not establish that its original justification remains valid.
answers: A practice's longevity does not establish that its original justification remains valid.
A practice's longevity doesn't establish that its original justification remains valid.
items.notes: longevity：长期延续；justification：理由依据。

items.zh: 制度转型需要考虑过渡期，否则最终收益可能被眼前困难抵消。
items.en: Institutional reform needs a transition plan, or immediate difficulties may undermine its eventual benefits.
answers: Institutional reform needs a transition plan, or immediate difficulties may undermine its eventual benefits.
items.notes: eventual：最终的；undermine：削弱。

items.zh: 退出安排若从未被讨论，试点项目可能在缺少评估的情况下自动延续。
items.en: Pilots may continue by default without evaluation when their exit arrangements have never been discussed.
answers: Pilots may continue by default without evaluation when their exit arrangements have never been discussed.
items.notes: by default：默认地；exit arrangement：退出安排。

items.zh: 长期承诺可以带来稳定，但也需要允许在证据变化时作出修订。
items.en: Long-term commitments provide stability but need scope for revision as the evidence changes.
answers: Long-term commitments provide stability but need scope for revision as the evidence changes.
items.notes: scope for：……的空间；as 表随之变化。

items.zh: 按相同金额补贴每个人看似平等，却可能忽略实际需要的差别。
items.en: Equal payments to everyone appear even-handed but may disregard differences in actual need.
answers: Equal payments to everyone appear even-handed but may disregard differences in actual need.
items.notes: even-handed：一视同仁的；disregard：忽略。

items.zh: 谁承担试验失败的代价，应与谁享有成功收益一起讨论。
items.en: Who bears the cost of experimental failure should be considered alongside who gains from success.
answers: Who bears the cost of experimental failure should be considered alongside who gains from success.
items.notes: 两个 who 从句分别说明成本承担者和受益者。

items.zh: 把服务迁到更便宜的地点，可能只是把成本从提供者转移给使用者。
items.en: Moving a service to a cheaper site may simply shift costs from the provider onto users.
answers: Moving a service to a cheaper site may simply shift costs from the provider onto users.
items.notes: shift costs from ... onto ...：将成本从一方转嫁给另一方。

items.zh: 平均收费不一定公平，因为偏远使用者还要支付额外交通费用。
items.en: A uniform fee is not necessarily equitable when remote users also incur extra travel costs.
answers: A uniform fee is not necessarily equitable when remote users also incur extra travel costs.
A uniform fee isn't necessarily equitable when remote users also incur extra travel costs.
items.notes: equitable：公平的；incur costs：承担费用。

items.zh: 让所有人等同样长的时间，不代表等待带来的影响相同。
items.en: Making everyone wait equally long does not mean that waiting has equal consequences.
answers: Making everyone wait equally long does not mean that waiting has equal consequences.
Making everyone wait equally long doesn't mean that waiting has equal consequences.
items.notes: 动名词主语；区分程序一致与实际影响。

items.zh: 评价效率时，如果不计算照护者的时间，就可能低估服务的真实成本。
items.en: An efficiency assessment that excludes carers' time may understate the true cost of a service.
answers: An efficiency assessment that excludes carers' time may understate the true cost of a service.
items.notes: exclude：不计入；understate：低估。

items.zh: 由自愿者提供必要服务可以扩大覆盖，却也可能让特定人群承担长期无偿劳动。
items.en: Essential services delivered by volunteers can widen coverage while placing sustained unpaid demands on particular groups.
answers: Essential services delivered by volunteers can widen coverage while placing sustained unpaid demands on particular groups.
items.notes: delivered by 限定服务；sustained demands：持续的劳动要求。

items.zh: 受益集中在少数群体，并不自动否定项目，但需要明确说明选择依据。
items.en: Concentrated benefits do not automatically invalidate a programme, but they require an explicit justification for the selection.
answers: Concentrated benefits do not automatically invalidate a programme, but they require an explicit justification for the selection.
Concentrated benefits don't automatically invalidate a programme, but they require an explicit justification for the selection.
items.notes: invalidate：否定有效性；explicit justification：明确依据。

items.zh: 公平可能要求不同支持，而不是仅仅提供相同资源。
items.en: Fairness may require differentiated support rather than the identical provision of resources.
answers: Fairness may require differentiated support rather than the identical provision of resources.
items.notes: differentiated：有区别的；rather than 区分公平路径。

items.zh: 如果新增服务只覆盖已经方便获得支持的人，名义扩张就可能扩大差距。
items.en: A nominal expansion may widen disparities if new services reach only people who already enjoy convenient support.
answers: A nominal expansion may widen disparities if new services reach only people who already enjoy convenient support.
items.notes: nominal：名义上的；disparity：差距。

items.zh: 有人担心弹性规则会造成混乱，但明确的例外标准可以减少任意判断。
items.en: Concerns that flexible rules invite confusion can be addressed through explicit criteria for exceptions.
answers: Concerns that flexible rules invite confusion can be addressed through explicit criteria for exceptions.
items.notes: concerns that 为同位语结构；address a concern：回应担忧。

items.zh: 认为费用过高是合理的质疑，却还不足以证明什么都不做成本更低。
items.en: A concern about high expenditure does not establish that inaction would cost less.
answers: A concern about high expenditure does not establish that inaction would cost less.
A concern about high expenditure doesn't establish that inaction would cost less.
items.notes: inaction：不采取行动；would 表假设后果。

items.zh: 支持改革不意味着忽视其代价，而意味着这些代价需要与现状比较。
items.en: Supporting reform entails comparing its costs with those of the status quo, rather than ignoring them.
answers: Supporting reform entails comparing its costs with those of the status quo, rather than ignoring them.
items.notes: entail：意味着需要；status quo：现状；those 代替 costs。

items.zh: 批评者指出了真实风险，但他们提出的替代方案也应接受同样的审查。
items.en: Critics identify a real risk, yet their alternative should be subject to equivalent scrutiny.
answers: Critics identify a real risk, yet their alternative should be subject to equivalent scrutiny.
items.notes: be subject to：接受；scrutiny：仔细审查。

items.zh: 即便某项措施能被滥用，也不能直接推出所有正当使用都应被禁止。
items.en: The possibility of misuse does not, by itself, justify prohibiting every legitimate use.
answers: The possibility of misuse does not, by itself, justify prohibiting every legitimate use.
The possibility of misuse doesn't, by itself, justify prohibiting every legitimate use.
items.notes: by itself：仅凭这一点；legitimate：正当的。

items.zh: 缺少完美方案并不免除我们比较现有选择的责任。
items.en: The absence of a perfect solution does not relieve us of the obligation to compare available options.
answers: The absence of a perfect solution does not relieve us of the obligation to compare available options.
The absence of a perfect solution doesn't relieve us of the obligation to compare available options.
items.notes: relieve ... of ...：免除……；obligation：责任。

items.zh: 以往一次执行失败，可能暴露的是设计问题，而非目标本身不可取。
items.en: A previous implementation failure may expose a design defect rather than an undesirable objective.
answers: A previous implementation failure may expose a design defect rather than an undesirable objective.
items.notes: implementation：执行；区分手段缺陷与目标价值。

items.zh: 我们可以接受对效果的质疑，同时拒绝对参与者动机的无根据猜测。
items.en: We can accept challenges to effectiveness while rejecting unsupported speculation about participants' motives.
answers: We can accept challenges to effectiveness while rejecting unsupported speculation about participants' motives.
items.notes: while 表同时区分两类批评；speculation：猜测。

items.zh: 在没有说明资源来源之前，扩大服务的承诺仍然不够完整。
items.en: A commitment to expand provision remains incomplete until its resource base has been specified.
answers: A commitment to expand provision remains incomplete until its resource base has been specified.
items.notes: resource base：资源来源；until 限定承诺完整的条件。

items.zh: 辩论最需要澄清的，可能是双方到底在用什么标准判断成功。
items.en: What the debate most needs may be clarity about the criteria by which each side judges success.
answers: What the debate most needs may be clarity about the criteria by which each side judges success.
items.notes: what 主语从句；by which 引导判断标准的定语从句。
